blocks.text: **Past Simple** (oddiy o'tgan zamon) — o'tmishda bo'lib o'tgan va tugagan harakat: kecha, o'tgan hafta, 2019-yilda. O'zbekchada unga ko'pincha **-di** mos keladi: ishla**di**m, bor**di**k, ko'r**di**. Farqi shundaki, inglizcha fe'l shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi: o'zbekchada «ishladim, ishlading, ishladi» — uch xil, inglizchada esa hammasi bitta: I **worked**, you **worked**, she **worked**. Present Simple dagi `-s` ham yo'qoladi: she work**s** → she **worked**.

Fe'llarning katta qismi **to'g'ri fe'l**: o'tgan zamon shakli `-ed` qo'shib yasaladi — work → work**ed**, play → play**ed**, want → want**ed**. Yozuvda ba'zan kichik o'zgarishlar bo'ladi: oxiridagi `-e` takrorlanmaydi, `-y` ba'zan `-i` ga aylanadi, ba'zan oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi. Bu qoidalarni hozir yaxshilab o'rganib olsangiz, keyin ham asqatadi: xuddi shu `-ed` shakli Present Perfect da ham ishlatiladi (15-dars).

rows: work → work**ed**, clean → clean**ed**, visit → visit**ed**
live → live**d**, like → like**d**, arrive → arrive**d**
study → stud**ied**, try → tr**ied**, carry → carr**ied**
play → play**ed**, stay → stay**ed**, enjoy → enjoy**ed**
stop → sto**pped**, plan → pla**nned**, drop → dro**pped**

blocks.text: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llarning ko'pi **noto'g'ri fe'l**: ular `-ed` olmaydi, o'tgan zamon shakli alohida yodlanadi: go → **went**, see → **saw**, buy → **bought**. Ularni qoida bilan topib bo'lmaydi, lekin yaxshi tomoni ham bor: noto'g'ri fe'l ham barcha shaxslarda bir xil (I **went**, she **went**, they **went**). Quyida kundalik nutqda eng ko'p kerak bo'ladiganlari; uchala shakli — 24-darsda, to'liq ro'yxat — 117–118-darslarda.

items: **o'tmishda tugagan bir martalik harakat**: I **lost** my phone yesterday. — Kecha telefonimni yo'qotdim;
**ketma-ket harakatlar** (hikoya): She **got up**, **had** breakfast and **went** to work.;
**o'tmishdagi odat yoki uzoq holat**: When I was a child, I **walked** to school every day. — o'zbekchada ko'pincha «-ardi»: piyoda borardim;
**hayot voqealari** (tarjimai hol): My parents **got married** in 1995. — o'zbekchada ko'pincha «-gan»: turmush qurishgan.

blocks.text: Past Simple da harakat qachon bo'lgani ko'pincha aytiladi yoki suhbatdan ma'lum: yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago, when I was ten (vaqt so'zlari — 10-dars jadvalida). O'zbekchada «-di», «-gan», «-ardi» — uch xil shakl bo'lishi mumkin, inglizchada esa uchalasiga ham ko'pincha bitta Past Simple to'g'ri keladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Yesterday I go to the bazaar.» → Yesterday I **went** to the bazaar. (o'tmish bo'lsa — fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda); «I was go / I was went to work.» → I **went** to work. (was oddiy fe'l bilan qo'shilmaydi: u faqat sifat, joy yoki ot bilan keladi — 10-dars); «She goed», «I buyed» → she **went**, I **bought**; «He studyed» → he **studied**; «She workeds» → she **worked** (o'tgan zamonda `-s` yo'q).

Noto'g'ri fe'llarni quruq ro'yxat qilib emas, gap ichida yodlang va o'zingiz haqingizda ayting: go — **went** (Yesterday I **went** to work), buy — **bought** (I **bought** some bread). Har kuni 5 ta fe'l — bir oyda eng kerakli yuztasi yodda bo'ladi.

Inkor va savol (I **didn't** go, **Did** you go?) — 12-dars. O'tmishda davom etayotgan harakat (I **was reading**) — 13-dars. To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llarning uch shakli — 24-dars, imlo qoidalari — 120-dars.

examples.title: Regular verbs: work**ed**, play**ed**, visit**ed**
examples.description: To'g'ri fe'llar: oddiy holatda fe'lga `-ed` qo'shiladi. Shakl barcha shaxslarda bir xil.

sentences.text: I **cleaned** my room on Saturday morning.
Yesterday it **rained** all day in London.
Aziz **worked** until ten o'clock last night.
We **watched** a very good film on TV.
The children **played** football in the park after school.
My aunt **visited** us last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari xolam bizga **mehmonga keldi**.

sentences.text: Emma **opened** the window because the room **was** hot.
sentences.translation: Xona issiq bo'lgani uchun Emma derazani **ochdi**.

sentences.text: Last year Sarah **started** a new job in Oxford.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Sara Oksfordda yangi **ishga kirdi**.

sentences.text: After dinner Dad **washed** the dishes and I **helped** him.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatdan keyin dadam idishlarni **yuvdi**, men esa unga **yordam berdim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **called** his mother and **asked** about her health.

examples.title: Spelling: live**d**, stud**ied**, sto**pped**
examples.description: Imlo: `-e` bilan tugasa — faqat `-d`; undosh + `-y` → `-ied`; unli + `-y` → `-yed`; stop, plan kabi qisqa fe'llarda undosh ikkilanadi.

sentences.text: We **arrived** in Bukhara late in the evening.
My parents **lived** in a small flat in Chilanzar for ten years.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Chilonzordagi kichkina kvartirada o'n yil **yashashgan**.

sentences.text: Madina **studied** medicine in Tashkent.
The bus **stopped** right in front of our house.
I **tried** the new café near the station, and I **liked** it a lot.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yonidagi yangi kafeni **sinab ko'rdim** va u menga juda **yoqdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **planned** the whole trip himself.
We **stayed** at a lovely hotel by the sea.
Everybody **enjoyed** the party, and nobody **hurried** home.
Oh no, I **dropped** my phone and the screen broke!
sentences.translation: Voy, telefonimni **tushirib yubordim**, ekrani sinib qoldi!

sentences.text: Dilnoza **carried** the heavy bags upstairs and then **prepared** dinner.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza og'ir sumkalarni yuqoriga **olib chiqdi**, keyin kechki ovqat **tayyorladi**.

examples.title: Irregular verbs: **went**, **came**, **got**, **had**
examples.description: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan noto'g'ri fe'llar: go → **went**, come → **came**, get → **got**, have → **had**, leave → **left**, take → **took**.

sentences.text: I **went** to the dentist yesterday.
Grandma **came** to our house on Sunday.
We **had** lunch at a little café near the river.
Bekzod **got** a new phone for his birthday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tug'ilgan kunida sovg'aga yangi telefon **oldi**.

sentences.text: The train **left** at six, so I **got up** very early.
sentences.translation: Poyezd oltida **jo'nadi**, shuning uchun juda erta **turdim**.

sentences.text: My sister **took** a lot of photos in Samarkand.
Last night we **went** to bed after midnight.
James **came** home late and **had** a quick dinner.
sentences.translation: Jeyms uyga kech **keldi** va tezgina **kechki ovqat qildi**.

sentences.text: In July my cousins **went** to London for two weeks.
After the lesson Madina **took** a taxi because it **was** late.
sentences.translation: Darsdan keyin kech bo'lgani uchun Madina **taksida ketdi**.

examples.title: More irregular verbs: **saw**, **bought**, **met**
examples.description: Yana kundalik noto'g'ri fe'llar: see → **saw**, buy → **bought**, eat → **ate**, meet → **met**, write → **wrote**, lose → **lost**, find → **found**, tell → **told**.

sentences.text: I **saw** your brother at the bus stop this morning.
Mum **bought** some fresh bread and cheese.
sentences.translation: Oyim yangi non va pishloq **sotib oldi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **ate** three plates of plov at the wedding!
We **met** in Tashkent in 2015.
Sarah **wrote** a long email to her teacher.
I **lost** my keys, but luckily my neighbour **found** them.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim**, xayriyat, qo'shnim ularni **topib oldi**.

sentences.text: Dad **made** breakfast for everybody on Sunday.
My grandfather **told** us a funny story about his school.
sentences.translation: Bobom bizga maktabi haqida kulgili bir voqea **aytib berdi**.

sentences.text: Emma **thought** the film **was** boring, so she **left** early.
sentences.translation: Emma filmni zerikarli **deb o'yladi** va erta **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday I **spent** two hours in the library and **read** three chapters.
sentences.translation: Kecha kutubxonada ikki soat **o'tkazdim** va uch bobni **o'qib chiqdim**.

examples.title: One thing after another: a busy day
examples.description: Ketma-ket harakatlar — bitta gapda bir nechta Past Simple fe'l: I got up, had a shower and went out. Hikoya shunday quriladi.

sentences.text: I **woke up** at six and **got up** at once.
Then I **had** a shower and **made** some tea.
At seven Dilnoza **left** the house and **walked** to the metro.
sentences.translation: Yettida Dilnoza uydan **chiqdi** va metroga **piyoda bordi**.

sentences.text: She **bought** a coffee, **sat** down and **read** the news on her phone.
sentences.translation: U qahva **sotib oldi**, **o'tirdi** va telefonida yangiliklarni **o'qidi**.

sentences.text: Tom **finished** work, **went** to the gym and **came** home at nine.
sentences.translation: Tom ishni **tugatdi**, sport zaliga **bordi** va soat to'qqizda uyga **keldi**.

sentences.text: First we **visited** the Registan, and after that we **had** lunch.
The plane **landed**, and the passengers **got off** quickly.
After breakfast the kids **put on** their coats and **ran** outside.
sentences.translation: Nonushtadan keyin bolalar kurtkalarini **kiyishdi** va tashqariga **yugurib chiqishdi**.

sentences.text: Mr Brown **opened** the letter, **read** it and **smiled**.
When the film **finished**, we **said** goodbye and **took** a taxi home.

examples.title: Life events: **moved**, **met**, **started**
examples.description: Hayot voqealari — yil yoki «... oldin» bilan. O'zbekchada bunday faktlar ko'pincha «-gan» bilan aytiladi: turmush qurishgan, tanishgan; inglizchada — Past Simple.

sentences.text: My parents **got married** in 1995.
Five years ago Bekzod **moved** to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Besh yil oldin Bekzod Toshkentga **ko'chib keldi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **finished** university in 2020 and **found** a job in a bank.
I **learnt** to swim when I **was** seven.
Grandad **built** this house with his own hands.
sentences.translation: Bobom bu uyni o'z qo'li bilan **qurgan**.

sentences.text: Aziz and Madina **met** at university and **became** good friends.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Madina universitetda **tanishishgan** va yaqin do'st **bo'lib qolishgan**.

sentences.text: In 2019 James **started** his own small business.
Last spring my sister **had** a baby boy.
We **bought** our first car a month ago.
sentences.translation: Bir oy oldin birinchi mashinamizni **sotib oldik**.

sentences.text: When Emma **was** twenty, she **went** to Spain and **taught** English there for a year.
sentences.translation: Emma yigirma yoshida Ispaniyaga **ketdi** va u yerda bir yil ingliz tilidan **dars berdi**.

examples.title: Past habits: When I was a child, I **walked** to school
examples.description: Past Simple o'tmishdagi odat va uzoq davom etgan holatni ham bildiradi. O'zbekchada bunda ko'pincha «-ardi» ishlatiladi: borardim, o'ynardik.

sentences.text: When I **was** a child, I **walked** to school every day.
My grandmother **knew** all her neighbours by name.
We **lived** in a village near Samarkand for twelve years.
sentences.translation: Biz o'n ikki yil Samarqand yaqinidagi qishloqda **yashaganmiz**.

sentences.text: Every summer Tom and his family **went** to the seaside.
sentences.translation: Har yozda Tom oilasi bilan dengiz bo'yiga **borardi**.

sentences.text: At school Dilnoza **liked** maths, but she **hated** sport.
sentences.translation: Maktabda Dilnoza matematikani **yaxshi ko'rardi**, sportni esa **yomon ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: My father **worked** in a factory when he **was** young.
In those days people **wrote** letters, not emails.
sentences.translation: U paytlarda odamlar elektron xat emas, qog'oz xat **yozishardi**.

sentences.text: Every evening Grandad **told** us stories before bed.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun bobom uxlashdan oldin bizga ertak **aytib berardi**.

sentences.text: As students, we always **had** lunch in the same cheap café.
sentences.translation: Talabalik paytimizda doim bitta arzon kafeda **tushlik qilardik**.

sentences.text: In winter the children **played** in the snow for hours.

examples.title: A weekend in Samarkand: mixed practice
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar hamda **was / were** bitta hikoyada.

sentences.text: Last Friday Aziz and his friends **took** the fast train to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: O'tgan juma kuni Aziz do'stlari bilan Samarqandga tezyurar poyezdda **jo'nadi**.

sentences.text: The journey **was** short and comfortable.
They **arrived** at noon and **checked in** at a small hotel.
sentences.translation: Ular tushda **yetib kelishdi** va kichik mehmonxonaga **joylashishdi**.

sentences.text: In the afternoon they **visited** the Registan and **took** hundreds of photos.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin Registonni **tomosha qilishdi** va yuzlab **surat olishdi**.

sentences.text: The weather **was** perfect: warm, sunny and not too hot.
sentences.translation: Havo **ajoyib edi**: iliq, quyoshli, lekin juda issiq emas.

sentences.text: In the evening they **ate** delicious kebabs at a local restaurant.
On Saturday Aziz **bought** some souvenirs for his family at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni Aziz bozordan oilasiga **esdalik sovg'alar oldi**.

sentences.text: His friend Bekzod **found** a beautiful old carpet and **paid** a lot for it.
sentences.translation: Do'sti Bekzod chiroyli eski gilam **topdi** va unga ko'p **pul to'ladi**.

sentences.text: They **came** back to Tashkent on Sunday night, tired but happy.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni kechasi ular charchagan, lekin xursand holda Toshkentga **qaytishdi**.

sentences.text: It **was** a short trip, but everybody **loved** it.
